integrity: Deductive proof from exact edgewise payoff conservation, best-response regret identity, linear algebra and a nonzero determinant monomial. Exact-rational finite tests provide supplementary verification. Historical priority beyond named accessible literature is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite bipartite graph with only conformist–rebel edges, common strictly positive reciprocal weights on edges, two equipotent binary actions, no intrinsic action bias. Genericity requires independent atomless positive weights; no assertion for arbitrary signed, correlated or within-type edge weights, dynamic selection or correlated equilibria.
title: Nash equilibria as nullspace polytopes in weighted conformist–rebel networks
